title: I Hear Thy Welcome Voice
lyrics: [C]I hear Thy welcome voice, That [G]calls me, Lord, to [C]Thee;
[C]For cleansing in Thy precious blood, That [G]flowed on [C]Calvary.
[C]Wash me, cleanse me, in the blood That [G7]flowed on [C]Calvary.
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust,
All hail! the gift of Christ, our Lord,
